en: The image shows an ornate interior hall with Gothic architectural elements, high ceilings, a large decorated fireplace, and stained glass windows. There are intricate wall sculptures depicting historical figures. The caption at the bottom reads 'Audenarde Intérieur de l'Hôtel de ville. Salle du peuple.' indicating it is the interior of the town hall of Audenarde (Oudenaarde) and specifically the 'Salle du peuple' (People's Hall). The reverse side is a typical vintage postcard layout with handwritten correspondence in German.
